description: Knowl retrieval evaluation suite — diverse, adversarial engineering knowledge base with distractors, stale/rejected traps, paraphrase, provenance, and filename queries.

fixtures.title: PostgreSQL as primary datastore
fixtures.content: PostgreSQL 16 is the primary transactional datastore for Northwind. Chosen for strong relational guarantees, JSONB, and mature replication.

fixtures.title: MongoDB as primary datastore
fixtures.content: MongoDB was evaluated and rejected as the primary store; the domain is highly relational and needs multi-row transactions.

fixtures.title: MySQL legacy datastore
fixtures.content: Early prototype used MySQL 5.7. Superseded by the PostgreSQL migration.

fixtures.title: Never run concurrent schema migrations
fixtures.content: Running two schema migrations concurrently against Postgres causes advisory-lock deadlocks. Migrations must run serially in CI.

fixtures.title: JWT access tokens with refresh rotation
fixtures.content: Authentication uses short-lived JWT access tokens (15m) plus rotating refresh tokens stored server-side. Access tokens are stateless; refresh tokens are revocable.

fixtures.title: Server-side session cookies
fixtures.content: Classic server-side session cookies were rejected for the API tier; the mobile clients need stateless bearer tokens.

fixtures.title: OAuth2 social login via Google and GitHub
fixtures.content: Third-party login is implemented with OAuth2 authorization code flow for Google and GitHub identity providers.

fixtures.title: src/auth/token.ts issues access tokens
fixtures.content: src/auth/token.ts exports createAccessToken and verifyAccessToken used by the API gateway.

fixtures.title: Stripe for billing and subscriptions
fixtures.content: Stripe handles subscriptions, invoicing, and payment methods. We do not store raw card data; only Stripe customer and payment-method IDs.

fixtures.title: Stripe webhooks must be idempotent
fixtures.content: Stripe can deliver the same webhook event more than once. Handlers key on event.id and ignore already-processed events to stay idempotent.

fixtures.title: PayPal as billing provider
fixtures.content: PayPal was rejected as the billing provider; Stripe covers our subscription and tax needs with one integration.

fixtures.title: OpenSearch for full-text product search
fixtures.content: Product catalog search runs on OpenSearch. Documents are indexed from Postgres via a change-data-capture stream.

fixtures.title: Rebuild the OpenSearch product index
fixtures.content: Run scripts/reindex-products.ts to rebuild the OpenSearch product index from the Postgres source of truth.

fixtures.title: Redis for caching and rate-limit counters
fixtures.content: Redis stores hot read caches and token-bucket rate-limit counters. It is treated as ephemeral; nothing authoritative lives only in Redis.

fixtures.title: SQS for asynchronous job processing
fixtures.content: Background jobs use Amazon SQS with a dead-letter queue after 5 failed attempts. Workers are idempotent.

fixtures.title: Kafka for job processing
fixtures.content: Kafka was rejected for simple background jobs; SQS is operationally cheaper and enough for our throughput.

fixtures.title: REST API with explicit versioning
fixtures.content: The public API is REST over HTTPS with URL versioning (/v1, /v2). Breaking changes require a new version; additive changes do not.

fixtures.title: GraphQL public API
fixtures.content: A GraphQL public API was rejected; REST with versioning is simpler for our partners to consume and cache.

fixtures.title: Public API rate limit is 600 requests per minute
fixtures.content: Each API key is limited to 600 requests per minute using a Redis token bucket; bursts up to 100 are allowed.

fixtures.title: React with server components for the web app
fixtures.content: The web client is React with server components and streaming SSR for first-paint performance.

fixtures.title: Client state via React Query, no global store
fixtures.content: Server state is managed with React Query; there is intentionally no Redux-style global store. Local UI state stays in components.

fixtures.title: Redux global store
fixtures.content: Early web app used a Redux global store. Replaced by React Query for server state.

fixtures.title: Kubernetes on EKS for service hosting
fixtures.content: Services run on Kubernetes (EKS). Each service is a Deployment behind a ClusterIP with an ingress for public routes.

fixtures.title: Terraform for infrastructure as code
fixtures.content: All cloud infrastructure is defined in Terraform. Manual console changes are prohibited and drift is detected nightly.

fixtures.title: Deploy a service to staging
fixtures.content: Run scripts/deploy.sh <service> staging to build, push, and roll out a service to the staging cluster.

fixtures.title: OpenTelemetry tracing to Grafana Tempo
fixtures.content: Distributed tracing uses OpenTelemetry SDKs exporting spans to Grafana Tempo. Trace IDs propagate through all internal calls.

fixtures.title: Structured JSON logs, no PII
fixtures.content: All logs are structured JSON and must never contain PII or secrets. A redaction middleware strips known sensitive keys.

fixtures.title: Vitest for unit and integration tests
fixtures.content: Unit and integration tests use Vitest. Every pull request must keep the suite green before merge.

fixtures.title: Playwright for end-to-end tests
fixtures.content: End-to-end browser tests use Playwright against a seeded staging environment nightly.

fixtures.title: Run the database test suite
fixtures.content: Run npm test -- tests/store/store.test.ts to execute the database repository tests.

fixtures.title: Secrets live in AWS Secrets Manager only
fixtures.content: Application secrets are stored exclusively in AWS Secrets Manager and injected at runtime. Secrets must never be committed to git or baked into images.

fixtures.title: Role-based access control with three roles
fixtures.content: Authorization uses RBAC with owner, admin, and member roles. Permission checks happen in a central policy module.

fixtures.title: Encrypt PII at rest with KMS
fixtures.content: Personally identifiable columns are encrypted at rest using envelope encryption with AWS KMS keys rotated yearly.

fixtures.title: Snowflake as the analytics warehouse
fixtures.content: Analytics data lands in Snowflake via a nightly ELT from Postgres and event streams. BI tools read only from Snowflake.

fixtures.title: Change data capture with Debezium
fixtures.content: Debezium captures row-level changes from Postgres WAL and publishes them to the event bus for search indexing and analytics.

fixtures.title: N+1 queries in the orders endpoint were fixed with a join
fixtures.content: The GET /orders endpoint had an N+1 query loading line items per order. Fixed by a single joined query with a dataloader fallback.

fixtures.title: Composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
fixtures.content: List queries scan by tenant then time; a composite index on (tenant_id, created_at) removed a slow sequential scan.

fixtures.title: Maintain 99.9% API uptime
fixtures.content: The reliability goal is 99.9% monthly uptime for the public API, measured by external synthetic checks.

fixtures.title: EU customer data stays in eu-west-1
fixtures.content: For GDPR, EU customer data must be stored and processed only in the eu-west-1 region.

fixtures.title: New engineer productive within one week
fixtures.content: A new engineer should ship a small change to production within their first week using the documented setup path.

fixtures.title: Worker concurrency limit is 20 per node
fixtures.content: Background worker concurrency is capped at 20 jobs per node to protect the database connection pool.

fixtures.title: Single monorepo for all services
fixtures.content: All services live in one monorepo to share types and CI. Chosen over polyrepo for atomic cross-service changes.
fixtures.reasoning: Atomic cross-service refactors and shared types outweigh polyrepo isolation.

fixtures.title: Polyrepo per service
fixtures.content: A polyrepo-per-service layout was rejected; cross-cutting changes became too painful to coordinate.

fixtures.title: Store all timestamps in UTC
fixtures.content: Every timestamp is stored in UTC; timezone conversion happens only at the presentation layer.

fixtures.title: UUIDv7 primary keys
fixtures.content: New tables use UUIDv7 primary keys for time-sortable, non-guessable identifiers instead of auto-increment integers.

fixtures.title: Soft deletes via deleted_at
fixtures.content: Rows are soft-deleted with a deleted_at timestamp; a nightly job hard-deletes rows older than 30 days.

fixtures.title: Feature flags via LaunchDarkly
fixtures.content: Feature rollout is controlled by LaunchDarkly flags evaluated at request time with a local fallback cache.

fixtures.title: Transactional email via Postmark
fixtures.content: Transactional email (receipts, password resets) is sent through Postmark; marketing email is out of scope for the app.

fixtures.title: Static assets served from CloudFront
fixtures.content: Static assets and the web bundle are served from CloudFront with long cache TTLs and content-hashed filenames.

fixtures.title: Deploys use blue-green rollout
fixtures.content: Production deploys use blue-green rollout with automated health checks before shifting traffic.

fixtures.title: Deploys use in-place rolling restart
fixtures.content: Older deploy method was an in-place rolling restart. Replaced by blue-green.

fixtures.title: Cut a production release
fixtures.content: Tag main with vX.Y.Z, let CI build and publish artifacts, then approve the production rollout in the deploy dashboard.

fixtures.title: Seed a local development database
fixtures.content: Run npm run db:seed to load fixture data into a local Postgres for development.

fixtures.title: Cursor-based pagination for list endpoints
fixtures.content: List endpoints use opaque cursor pagination, not offset/limit, to stay stable under concurrent inserts.

fixtures.title: Secrets injected as env vars at pod start
fixtures.content: A CSI driver mounts Secrets Manager values and exposes them as environment variables when a pod starts.

fixtures.title: Raw event logs retained for 90 days
fixtures.content: Raw event and access logs are retained for 90 days, then aggregated and purged to control storage cost and privacy exposure.

fixtures.title: WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility is required
fixtures.content: The web app must meet WCAG 2.1 AA; automated axe checks run in CI and block merges on regressions.

fixtures.title: RFC 7807 problem+json error bodies
fixtures.content: API errors use RFC 7807 application/problem+json bodies with a stable type URI, title, status, and detail.

fixtures.title: Max 100 Postgres connections per service
fixtures.content: Each service caps its PgBouncer pool at 100 connections; workers and web share the budget to avoid exhausting Postgres.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: checkout timeout
fixtures.content: Incident: a slow tax lookup caused checkout timeouts under load; the tax call is now cached.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: duplicate charge
fixtures.content: Incident: a webhook replay double-charged customers; handlers are now idempotent by event id.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: index missing
fixtures.content: Incident: a missing index made the orders report time out; a composite index fixed it.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: cache stampede
fixtures.content: Incident: a cache expiry stampede overloaded Postgres; a request coalescing lock was added.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: clock skew
fixtures.content: Incident: JWT validation failed intermittently due to node clock skew; NTP is now enforced.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: leaked key
fixtures.content: Incident: an API key was committed to git and rotated; secret scanning now blocks pushes.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: queue poison
fixtures.content: Incident: a poison message stalled the worker queue; a dead-letter queue was added.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: n plus one cart
fixtures.content: Incident: the cart page issued a query per item; it now batches with a dataloader.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: oom import
fixtures.content: Incident: a bulk import ran out of memory; imports now stream in batches.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: deadlock migration
fixtures.content: Incident: two migrations deadlocked in CI; migrations now run serially.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: cors block
fixtures.content: Incident: a CORS misconfiguration blocked the partner portal; origins are now explicit.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: timezone bug
fixtures.content: Incident: reports were off by a day due to local-time math; all math is now UTC.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: retry storm
fixtures.content: Incident: aggressive retries caused a retry storm; a retry budget with backoff was added.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: stale cache price
fixtures.content: Incident: a stale price cache showed wrong prices; cache is now invalidated on price change.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: unbounded export
fixtures.content: Incident: an unbounded export filled the disk; exports now paginate and expire.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: session fixation
fixtures.content: Incident: a session fixation risk was found; session ids rotate on login.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: thundering deploy
fixtures.content: Incident: an in-place restart dropped requests; deploys moved to blue-green.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: pii in logs
fixtures.content: Incident: PII leaked into logs; a redaction middleware now strips sensitive keys.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: hot partition
fixtures.content: Incident: a hot Kafka-style partition lagged; keys were rebalanced.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: flag default on
fixtures.content: Incident: a feature flag defaulted on in prod; flags now fail closed to off.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: double refund
fixtures.content: Incident: a race allowed double refunds; refunds are now guarded by a unique key.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: slow regex
fixtures.content: Incident: a catastrophic regex hung a request thread; the pattern was bounded.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: missing backpressure
fixtures.content: Incident: the collector dropped events under spikes; backpressure was added.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: orphaned media
fixtures.content: Incident: deleted products left orphaned images; a cleanup job now reclaims them.

fixtures.title: Postmortem: token in url
fixtures.content: Incident: a reset token appeared in a URL and got logged; tokens moved to the body.
